event.event_name: 2015-2016 El Nino drought impacts across the tropical Pacific and global tropics

decision_rule.rule: Pass when observed_fraction <= 1/3, deficit_fraction >= 2/3, and water_source_stress_score equals 1.0; report local precipitation spread separately.

criteria.name: answer_schema
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON with answer, palau_deficit, water_source_stress_score, local_window, precipitation_spread, and interpretation.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points if all required information is present but not valid JSON; award 1 point for a prose summary with some required values.

criteria.name: palau_deficit_calculation
criteria.description: Correctly computes normal_rain_in = 30, observed_fraction = 0.267, deficit_fraction = 0.733, and deficit_mm = 558.8.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 3 points for correct formulas with one arithmetic or rounding error; award up to 2 points for identifying the 8 inch and 22 inch inputs without all derived values.

criteria.name: threshold_and_water_proxy
criteria.description: Correctly applies the two-part drought threshold and reports threshold_pass = true, then computes water_source_stress_score = 1.0 from two stressed drinking-water flags.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the threshold result alone and 1-2 points for a partially correct water-source proxy.

criteria.name: window_and_precipitation_ledger
criteria.description: Correctly reports event_days = 366, local_days = 46, coverage_fraction = 0.126, ensemble_mean_mm = 229.04, range_mm = 85.58, and range_pct_of_mean = 37.37.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for correct window arithmetic and up to 2 points for correct precipitation-product arithmetic.

criteria.name: numeric_reasoning_consistency
criteria.description: Explains that the Palau deficit and water-source proxy drive the drought-stress classification while the 46-day product spread is a local numeric check.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a correct but terse interpretation.

criteria.name: claim_scope_control
criteria.description: Avoids exact loss accounting or broad country-to-country comparisons from these calculations and keeps the conclusion tied to the computed threshold diagnostics.
criteria.partial_credit: No partial credit unless the answer is otherwise tightly scoped with only one minor overstatement.

provenance.notes: Computed only from local CSX-171 package values.
